answer: Admission should start at a nadir of zero voting weight and stay there until the agent produces a unique quartz proof: a time-locked commitment whose preimage is a transcript of original work that cannot be reused by any other address. Those proofs are checked by an orchard of task-specific verifiers (answer peers, graders, and delayed-reveal auditors), each drawn from disjoint recent neighborhoods. If two addresses present colliding transcripts or correlated clocks, both bonds are slashed and neither leaves the floor. Multiplying keys then multiplies locked capital, not influence.
